commands.cmd:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$tracked = @(git --no-optional-locks ls-files)
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
$protected = @($tracked | Where-Object { $_ -like 'src/*' -or $_ -like 'gradle/*' -or $_ -match '(^|/)(build\.gradle|settings\.gradle|gradle\.properties|gradlew|gradlew\.bat)$' } | Sort-Object)
$rows = foreach ($p in $protected) { $h = (Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath $p).Hash; $p + "`t" + $h }
$sha = [System.Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::Create()
$digest = [BitConverter]::ToString($sha.ComputeHash([System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes(($rows -join "`n")))).Replace('-', '')
$sha.Dispose()
Write-Output ('Protected tracked files=' + $protected.Count)
Write-Output ('Aggregate SHA256=' + $digest)
Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar | Format-List Path,Hash
